description: This PHP class 'RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor' extends an abstract processor and handles registration event processing related to employee activation. It interacts with employee service traits and manages event data related to employee count and activation status within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that handles registration event for tracking active employee counts, utilizing employee service traits and generating relevant event data.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the event type identifier for active employee count events.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Gathers and returns event data including current employee count filtered for active employees.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether the registration event should be saved based on employee count thresholds.
